text.p: Results in the latest round of Sunday League (40 overs) cricket matches:

At Southampton: Hampshire beat Warwickshire by 14 runs. Hampshire 278-4 in 40 overs (M.Hayden 118, G.White 67, S.Udal 50 not out). Warwickshire 264 all out in 39.4 overs (D.Ostler 70, A.Giles 57, N.Smith 52; J.Bovill 4-44).
At Ilford: Yorkshire beat Essex by 4 wickets. Essex 262-9 in 40 overs. Yorkshire 264-6 in 36.5 overs (D.Byas 72, M.Baughan 66, D.Lehmann 58 not out).
At Lord's: Northamptonshire beat Middlesex by 67 runs. Northamptonshire 198-7 in 40 overs (K.Curren 66, A.Penberthy 53). Middlesex 131 all out in 33.5 overs (J.Pooley 55; K.Curran 4-36).
At Trent Bridge: Kent beat Nottinghamshire by 46 runs. Kent 252-7 in 40 overs (G.Cowdrey 81 not out, M.Walker 78). Nottinghamshire 206-9 in 40 overs (N.Gie 75 not out).
At Worcester: Worcestershire beat Somerset by 85 runs. Worcestershire 262-4 in 40 overs (G.Hick 119 not out). Somerset 177 all out in 32.2 overs (R.Turner 67).
At Leicester: Lancashire beat Leicestershire by 5 wickets. Leicestershire 258-5 in 40 overs (D.Maddy 85, J.Whitaker 74). Lancashire 259-5 in 38.4 overs (J.Gallian 104, N.Fairbrother 50 not out).
At Pontypridd: Glamorgan beat Durham by 6 wickets. Durham 183-8 in 40 overs (N.Speak 74 not out). Glamorgan 184-4 in 30.5 overs.
